scripts.setup:
cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && python3.11 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && echo '
✅ Setup complete! Run: npm start'
scripts.start: concurrently "cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000" "cd frontend && npm run dev" --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "blue,green"
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
